title: Experience for Class B license.
officialText:
All applicants for a class B oil-burning equipment installer license shall submit
satisfactory proof establishing that the applicant has had at least three years practical experience within the five years prior to
application in the installation of oil-burning equipment under the direct and continuing supervision of a licensed oil-burning
equipment installer in the city.
